article_title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The Pope cancelled a planned hospital visit because he felt well.
Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer after successful surgery and is expected to recover in hospital.
The Vatican announced that all papal travel would stop permanently.
Doctors found that the Pope's lung nodule was not cancerous.
tasks.correct_answer: Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer after successful surgery and is expected to recover in hospital.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת באבחון סרטן הריאות של האפיפיור לאחר ניתוח מוצלח ובהמשך ההחלמה הצפוי שלו בבית החולים.

tasks.prompt: What did surgeons remove during the operation?
options: The whole lower lobe of his right lung
A small part of his left lung
Both lungs
Only a sample of skin
tasks.correct_answer: The whole lower lobe of his right lung
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המנתחים הסירו את כל האונה התחתונה של הריאה הימנית כדי להבטיח טיפול יסודי.

tasks.prompt: What does “contained” mean when the Pope described the nodule?
options: It had spread throughout his body.
It was hidden from the doctors.
It appeared limited to one area.
It had disappeared without treatment.
tasks.correct_answer: It appeared limited to one area.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה contained פירושו שהגידול נראה מוגבל לאזור מסוים ולא מפושט.

tasks.prompt: How long is Pope Leo expected to remain in hospital?
options: One night
About one month
Until his Latin America trip ends
About a week
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, האפיפיור צפוי להישאר בבית החולים כשבוע.

tasks.prompt: Why was the Pope's schedule cleared until 20 October?
options: To give him time to recover after surgery
To allow him to move permanently to the hospital
Because he had decided to retire
Because the Vatican was closed to visitors
tasks.correct_answer: To give him time to recover after surgery
tasks.explanation_hebrew: פינוי לוח הזמנים נועד לאפשר לו לנוח ולהחלים לאחר הניתוח.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “a bolt from the blue” mean?
options: A routine medical result
An unexpected and shocking event
A sign of good weather
A planned public announcement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי a bolt from the blue מתאר ידיעה מפתיעה ומטלטלת שהגיעה ללא ציפייה.

tasks.prompt: What did the Vatican report about the operation and the Pope's condition afterwards?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהניתוח נמשך 90 דקות, הצליח ללא סיבוכים, שהאפיפיור התעורר כרגיל וחזר לחדרו לאחר השגחה קצרה.
expected_points: The Vatican said it was successful and had no complications.
The Pope woke normally after surgery.
He returned to his room after a brief period of observation.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the lung problem was found, treated and diagnosed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את הבדיקות השגרתיות, גילוי הגוש בשלב מוקדם, החלטת הרופאים להסירו, הסרת האונה והאבחנה של אדנוקרצינומה.
expected_points: A lung lump was detected during routine checks.
The Pope said it was found at a very early stage and doctors advised removal.
Surgeons removed the lower lobe of his right lung.
Examination confirmed pulmonary adenocarcinoma after the operation.

tasks.prompt: Why are further tests being carried out even though the surgery was successful?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהצלחת הניתוח והיעדר סיבוכים אינם מוכיחים שהמחלה לא התפשטה, ולכן נדרשות בדיקות נוספות.
expected_points: The operation successfully removed the affected lung lobe.
Doctors still need to determine whether cancer cells have spread elsewhere.
A successful procedure does not by itself answer every question about the disease.
The test results can guide later medical decisions.

tasks.prompt: Write a short, neutral update about Pope Leo's health using only facts from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את האבחנה, הצלחת הניתוח, היעדר הסיבוכים, השהייה הצפויה בבית החולים והבדיקות הנוספות, ללא ניחושים.
expected_points: State that Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung adenocarcinoma after surgery.
Mention that the lower lobe of his right lung was removed successfully without complications.
Say that he is expected to remain in hospital for about a week.
Note that further tests are checking whether the cancer has spread.
